episodes.175824: A strong early season cold front dropped across the state from the northwest, which generated strong and nearly stationary thunderstorms. These storms produced high rainfall rates that resulted in some flash flooding impacts.
episodes.175953: A surface low developed in the northwestern Gulf of Mexico on December 19th and tracked eastward across the northern Gulf through the afternoon and evening hours. A warm front oriented west-to-east appendant to that low, was the focal point for thunderstorms in the local coastal waters. A couple storms along and south of the warm front in the warm sector, where warm and moist air was in place, reached severe limits and producing severe thunderstorm winds on an oil platform.
episodes.179523: Heavy rainfall observed on December 20,2022 prompted a flood warning for Unalaska, a city along the Aleutian Chain, where 3-4 inches of rainfall led their Public Safety to issue a precautionary Cat 2 travel advisory (only drive when necessary; Cat 3 closes travel).  About a 1 mile stretch of Ballyhoo Road was closed due to flooding and debris on the roadway.  Manholes were displaced to allow for better drainage.

events.narrative: Emergency management reported the upper portion of Palani Rd. was flooded.
Waikoloa Village was flooded along Waikoloa Road near the Paniolo Avenue intersection. Also, Highway 190 was closed near mile marker 5-6 due to debris on the road.
Kawaihae Road near the Kohala Mountain Road junction was flooded.
